caption: Test split, run 0, n = 743, list prices 2026-10-12. One panel per router and mix. Each panel draws the router alone and its three cascades (the free checks, the Jev gate, the Sonnet gate) on the router's frozen thresholds, joined by straight lines in linear cost from A, with a cross at each operating point (one per quality target: 100%, 99% and 97% of A's quality, the dotted lines). Crosses are 95% intervals from 2,000 resamples of source groups within each task. Each cross is a frozen operating point: the threshold or cutoff the walk on dev chose before test was touched (routers/operating_points.json), evaluated here and not walked, labeled with its target. A step line joins A to the distinct frozen dials that route, strictest first, each evaluated on the split once; it is not a walk and shows no step the walk did not choose, so it is shorter than dev's, which shows every step the walk tried. A cascade that falls back to A has its cross at A. Where two lines coincide the later shows: the free checks' line is drawn first, wider and fainter, and the router's own on top. A router-started cascade's steps are its router's frozen thresholds at the gate's fixed cutoff (from train), and its costs include the router's overhead where it has one (G and G+: Jev's) and every gate call made. Differences between policies are judged by the paired intervals in the tables, not by whether crosses overlap.

units.cascades: the 15 cascades, keyed by section key: label, start (the pure cascades start at haiku, the others at a router), gate, the operating-points file that holds the section and the sha256 of the section
units.panel_cascades: a panel's `cascades`: per cascade its label, gate and steps from A, then each distinct frozen dial that routes, strictest first, with its quality and cost_per_1k on test, joined by straight lines in linear cost
units.point: the free-checks-only cascade's one step as a point with a cross: its quality and cost_per_1k on test, each its value with its percentile 95% interval (low, high) and standard error; the cascade has no dial
units.operating_points: the frozen points' rows, keyed by quality target: threshold (the router's), cutoff (the gate's), fell_back, quality and cost_per_1k with intervals, difference from A, savings against A, captured fraction, routing mix, escalation rate and the matched-cost comparison
units.routed_panels: the router-started figure's panels, one per mix: A, the envelope's corners, the targets, and per router four lines on the router's frozen thresholds: the router alone and its three cascades, each with steps and operating points
